phantaskippy:

 

Foote wrote:
 phantaskippy wrote:
Nightmist has...better consistent healing [than scholar]   
Big shock here. But I 100% disagree with that. His innate power alone makes his healing more consistent, and thats not even touching on the cards within each deck and their practical applications.
. . .with 2-3 cards in play. . .
With 2-3 cards in play scholar can regain 3hp a turn unless he has healing one shots.Nightmist can beat that with master of magic and starshield necklace, if you have your redirection it is even better.The odds of Nightmist having a spell card to play and a card to discard are better than Scholar having a one shot that heals.Then Scholar's big heal is based on damage dealt, and needs targets to hit.  Nightmist needs someone's trash to be large, and with how she burns cards that is a very easily achieved status. 

Nightmist needs 1 of two cards of her deck in play to even start healing from spells (and those heals from master of magic function more as a mitigation tool to the damage she takes from those spells and rarely actually nets health). Scholar starts with an innate power that heals him and a suite of one-shots that also heal him regardless of whether he has forms out or not (those just make the healing better). If this is about healing consistency, scholar has nightmist beat up and down the block.
